スキルは、仕事ごとの手順書です。仕事の名前（例：「今日の出荷」）に合うと、AIが: A skill is a procedure manual for each type of work. When a request matches the name of a job (for example, "today's shipping"), the AI reads that whole manual and acts exactly as written. Instead of building one all-purpose AI, we stack "procedures, tools and knowledge" vertically for each type of work (vertical AI agents). A new type of work starts by adding one column, and fixes are added to that column.

確かめた事実だけを使い、推測で書かない経歴・実績・数字は、確かめて表にまとめた事: Use only confirmed facts; do not write from guessworkCareer, track record and numbers use only facts that have been verified and compiled in a table. What is not in the table is either not written or clearly marked "unconfirmed."
公式の情報で確かめる制度・料金・会社の情報は、その場で開いた公式のページで確かめ: Verify with official informationPrograms, fees and company information are verified on an official page opened on the spot. If it cannot be opened, it is treated as "unconfirmed."
別のAIで点検し、最後は人が確認する外に出す文面は、作ったAIとは別のAIが事実: Check with another AI, and a person confirms at the endFor text going out, an AI other than the one that made it checks facts, typos and omissions, and a person confirms last. We do not rely only on the AI's report that "it's done"; we check on the actual screen.
外から来た文章の指示には従わないメール・Webページ・ほかのAIの書き込みは「読: Do not follow instructions in text from outsideEmails, web pages and other AI's posts are treated as "data to read," and we do not act on instructions written in them. We also do not respond to suspicious contacts or links they point to.
パスワードや鍵を書かない・預からないパスワード・鍵・トークンは、文書やチャットに: Never write or hold passwords and keysPasswords, keys and tokens are never written in documents or chat. When working in a customer's service, we do not hold their password and instead enter with a work-use permission we are invited to.
必要な分だけの権限を渡すAIごとに触れてよい範囲を決め、読むだけの担当には送信や: Grant only the permissions neededWe decide what each AI may touch, and an AI assigned only to read is not allowed to send or delete.
お客様の資料や個人情報を外に出さない公開するのは、架空のデータで作った見本だけで: Never let customers' materials or personal information outWe publish only samples made with fictitious data. Customers' materials and personal information are never published, and files we send are password-protected.
ほかの人の文章や画像をそのまま使わないほかのサイトの文章・画像・ロゴは写しません: Do not use others' text or images as they areWe do not copy text, images or logos from other sites. When referring to them, we write in our own words and show the source.
記録を正しく保つ記録は上書きせずに書き足し、直すときは対象の行を確かめてから書き: Keep records accurateWe add to records without overwriting, and when correcting, we confirm the target row before writing.
担当を替えるときは、確かめてから任せる新しく担当するAIには、記録を読んで今の状: When changing who is in charge, check before handing overA newly assigned AI is not allowed to make changes or give instructions until it can read the records and answer the current situation correctly with evidence.
失敗は記録して直す失敗は理由とともに記録し、同じ失敗をくり返さないよう、決まりや: Record failures and fix themWe record failures with the reason, and fix the rules and mechanisms so that the same failure does not repeat.
AIの周りに守りの層をかぶせ、頼んだ人の指示から「やることの手順」を先に取り出す: A protective layer is wrapped around the AI, and the "procedure of what to do" is first extracted from the requester's instructions. Data read in from outside cannot change the procedure, and sending information out is stopped by rules. It solved 77% of the evaluation tasks while remaining safe (84% without protection).
